remarks: Builder's Opportunity - Solid Foundation, Premium Materials Included  Rare 1.2-acre riverfront parcel in desirable West Norwalk, offering stone walkways, mature landscaping, and exceptional natural privacy. The existing structure is ready for rebuild from the deck up on a solid, existing foundation, providing a meaningful head start for builders seeking a high-end custom project in a sought-after location.  The property includes over $400,000 in new premium materials, including custom windows, sliders, and doors. Builders may remain within the current footprint or pursue a new design; a thoughtfully executed second level has the potential to position the property in the $1.2M resale range, subject to final plans and execution.
